column1: # The D13 error registry's JSON-RPC codes, pinned (design D10, D13).
# A wire code is a compatibility contract in the same way a serde field name is: a
# deployed client already knows the value, so a change to one has to be a diff a human
# reads rather than a test that keeps passing. `codes.rs`'s walk compares this file
# against `ErrorKind::ALL` in both directions — a kind with no row fails, and a row
# naming something that is not a kind fails — so it cannot fall behind the registry.
# The names are each kind's own serde spelling, so this table cannot pin a word the
# registry does not use. The codes are `api::codes::rpc_code`'s; why the block sits where
# it does is stated once, on `api::codes::D13_CODES`, and not repeated here.
# `unimplemented` holds the block's lowest code on purpose: it is transitional (note N6)
# and P4d deletes it, so P4d raises `D13_CODES.start()` by one and the other eighteen
